spanish: Y hizo el lavatorio de bronce y su peana de bronce, con los espejos de las sirvientes que sirvieron a la abertura de la tienda de reunión.
readerNote: hold: clause role — the Hebrew construct "entrance of the tent of meeting" carries no preposition or article, so whether it stands as a bare locative adjunct of "served" (at the entrance) or is governed some other way is left as drafted, unrepaired.
